constraints: DBB; scope and budget changes require macro approval

owner_requirements.project_scope: 本模拟包为「口岸人工岛连接线路基与路面工程包材料采购」（包号 CASE-0005/supply-1），由中交第一航务工程局有限公司（COMP-0153）作为施工包承包商以买方身份支付，预算 MOP 23,205,000 已含于施工合同价内。供应范围仅限为约18,500平方米范围内的路基处理、路面结构层、排水与附属土建施工供应所需材料与构配件，包括供货、运输到场、质量证明文件交付及质保期内更换；不含任何施工、安装、临时工程、措施费或施工界面责任。本包自行采购材料，候选供应商为 COMP-0154 与 COMP-0167。业主方模拟目标为在24个月工期与 DBB 模式下，通过供应包价格确定性、质量证明文件可追溯性与到场节奏匹配性，守住施工包成本边界与工期承诺。
functional_requirements: 按施工包材料需求清单供应路基处理与路面结构层所需材料与构配件，满足约18,500平方米施工范围的用量与规格要求。
供货到场节奏须匹配路基处理、路面结构层、排水与附属土建的施工计划，避免停工等料冲击关键线路。
提供可追溯的质量证明文件清单，按统一格式交付，支撑路基与路面结构层按规范验收。
明确质保期内材料更换责任与响应安排，确保不合格材料可追溯、可更换。
提供材料与构配件的接口信息，便于施工包承包商协调现场安装与施工界面。
配合临时交通疏解与管线迁改窗口期的材料到场安排，降低占道时间延长带来的安全与环境压力。
technical_requirements: 材料规格与性能须满足路基处理及路面结构层设计目标，并提交与设计要求的对照说明。
质量证明文件须覆盖出厂检验、批次追溯与到场验收环节，形成可核查的记录链。
供货计划须与施工包24个月工期里程碑衔接，明确分批到场节点与提前通知机制。
材料包装、运输与现场交接须考虑口岸人工岛连接线的运输通道与临时交通疏解条件。
提供材料耐久性与可维护性说明，支撑路面结构层全生命周期质量目标。
明确材料存储与保护建议，降低到场后因存储不当导致的品质下降风险。
配合施工包承包商的 BIM 与施工协调信息需求，提供材料接口与到场批次信息。
质保期更换条款须可核查，明确更换触发条件、响应时限与责任边界。
owner_requirements.budget_policy: 本包预算 MOP 23,205,000 已含于施工包合同价内，由 COMP-0153 作为买方支付。业主方模拟评审以价格基础说明为核心：要求候选供应商书面明确单价是否锁定至供货完成、单价有效期及调价触发条件。在当前材料价格指数 1.112 的环境下，未锁定单价有效期的报价列为需澄清事项，评标时综合比较价格确定性、质量证明文件交付安排与到场节奏可行性，而非仅比较报价高低。
owner_requirements.schedule_policy: 供货到场节奏须匹配施工包24个月工期及路基处理、路面结构层、排水与附属土建的关键线路。评标阶段要求候选供应商提交供货到场节奏说明，明确分批到场节点、提前通知周期与应急补货安排。业主方模拟评审将考量到场节奏与施工计划的衔接度、临时交通疏解窗口期的配合能力，以及质量证明文件交付时间对验收节点的影响。
compliance_requirements: 业主方模拟评审须在评标前取得候选供应商书面价格基础说明，明确单价锁定至供货完成及调价触发条件。
质量证明文件清单须按统一格式提交，作为技术评审准入项，未按格式提交者不进入价格比较。
供货到场节奏说明须作为交付可行性判读依据，纳入评标记录。
质保期内材料更换承诺须形成书面条款，纳入合同条件设定。
评标过程须保留澄清事项记录，未锁定单价有效期的报价须列明澄清要求与回复。
业主方模拟评审须跟踪材料价格指数变化对供应包价格确定性的影响，并记录于评标报告。
供应包判给须经业主方模拟评审确认价格基础、质量证明文件与到场节奏三项核心条件后方可作出。
risk_priorities: 材料价格指数波动风险：当前指数 1.112，若单价未锁定或调价触发条件不清，价格波动将全部压至施工包合同价。
质量证明文件不可追溯风险：到场材料缺少可追溯检验记录将导致返工，直接冲击24个月工期。
到场节奏脱节风险：材料供应跟不上施工计划将造成停工等料，错过临时交通疏解与管线迁改窗口期。
质保期更换责任不清风险：更换条款不可核查将放大不合格材料返工与现场安全风险。
候选供应商报价基础差异风险：COMP-0154 与 COMP-0167 报价基础未核实前，判给信心不足。

negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Total price MOP 20,490,000 with the bid breakdown unchanged. Unit prices for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料 are locked through completion of supply, covering all batches from first arrival to acceptance of the last batch, with no adjustment for material price index movement within that scope. Acceptance standards lists for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料, plus the batch nonconformity isolation and written notification procedure, are contract attachments.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment per batch: within 30 days after that batch passes arrival acceptance, pay 80% of the batch price; the balance is settled after warranty expiry with no outstanding unrectified nonconformities. negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Batch arrival nodes follow the buyer-confirmed construction schedule; a batch arrival node table is a contract attachment specifying each batch advance-notice period and emergency replenishment arrangements. negotiated_clauses.scope_and_interfaces: COMP-0167 supplies only materials and components for the construction package 口岸人工岛连接线路基与路面工程包: supply, transport to site, quality certification documents, and warranty-period replacement. Excluded: any construction, installation, temporary works, measure costs, and construction-interface responsibility. Materials cost is included in the parent construction package fixed price; COMP-0153 as the construction contractor is the buyer and pays. The construction package scope (used only to determine required materials, not part of this package) is about 18,500 square meters of subgrade treatment, pavement structural layers, drainage and ancillary civil works, including temporary traffic diversion and utility relocation within that package, excluding bridge-end structural transition sections. This package self-procures materials. Delivery handover is at the buyer-designated receiving point against acceptance records. Transport plan coordinates with the 口岸人工岛 connecting-line corridor conditions and temporary traffic diversion windows.
negotiated_clauses.price_and_change_control: Total price MOP 20,490,000 with the bid breakdown unchanged. Unit prices for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料 are locked through completion of supply, covering all batches from first arrival to acceptance of the last batch, with no adjustment for material price index movement within that scope. For 排水与附属土建材料及构配件 only, the base is material price index 1.112; when the index moves beyond plus or minus 5%, the excess is settled batch by batch using 调价额 = 该批合同金额 x (当期指数 - 1.112) / 1.112; no adjustment when within the threshold. The previously listed 需澄清 unlocked portions are resolved by these two rules and no longer remain open. The MOP 760,000 price risk boundary is a risk provision under this lock-and-adjust mechanism and does not create additional exposure for the buyer. No uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope; any request beyond these rules remains unresolved and requires re-tendering. Acceptance standards lists for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料, plus the batch nonconformity isolation and written notification procedure, are contract attachments.
negotiated_clauses.payment_terms: Payment per batch: within 30 days after that batch passes arrival acceptance, pay 80% of the batch price; the balance is settled after warranty expiry with no outstanding unrectified nonconformities. Payment nodes and ratios are written into the contract body and are not merely referenced to the bid document. Currency is MOP.
negotiated_clauses.delivery_and_review: Batch arrival nodes follow the buyer-confirmed construction schedule; a batch arrival node table is a contract attachment specifying each batch advance-notice period and emergency replenishment arrangements. Each batch is preceded by advance notice to the buyer and accompanied by factory inspection reports and batch traceability records; the supplier cooperates with the buyer in completing arrival acceptance records. Quality documents use the unified format covering factory inspection, batch traceability, and arrival acceptance, with one-to-one batch numbering; independent sampling review and a rectification closed-loop apply. Warranty replacement: response within 24 hours for material nonconformity with design indicators or batch quality defects, and within 48 hours for transport arrival damage, after written notice; nonconforming batches are isolated and the buyer notified in writing within 24 hours, included in batch traceability and rectification closed loop. Replacement materials are re-issued quality documents and included in batch traceability. Team availability and role plan (supply coordination, quality document management, warranty response) are stated on a planned basis as a binding staffing obligation, not as already implemented. Alternative sources and emergency replenishment are accepted as stated risk allocation; portions without written supplier quotations are listed as internal estimates and are the supplier's risk.
negotiated_clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0153 decisions are binding: (1) unit prices for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料 are locked through completion of supply across all batches, with no index adjustment in that scope; (2) index adjustment applies only to 排水与附属土建材料及构配件, base 1.112, threshold plus or minus 5%, formula 调价额 = 该批合同金额 x (当期指数 - 1.112) / 1.112, settled batch by batch; (3) the former 需澄清 unlocked portions are closed by rules (1) and (2), and the MOP 760,000 price risk boundary is a risk provision under this mechanism, not additional buyer exposure; (4) acceptance standards lists for 路基处理材料 and 路面结构层材料 and the batch nonconformity isolation and written notification procedure are contract attachments. Supplier COMP-0167 positions accepted and written as obligations: payment of 80% of each batch price within 30 days after arrival acceptance, balance after warranty expiry with no unrectified nonconformities; batch arrival node table as a contract attachment with advance-notice periods and emergency replenishment; warranty response within 24 hours for design-indicator nonconformity or batch defects and within 48 hours for transport damage, with batch isolation and written buyer notice within 24 hours. The supplier's disclosed assumptions on alternative sources and emergency replenishment internal estimates, planned-basis team availability, and the buyer being the construction contractor are accepted as stated risk allocations. Price MOP 20,490,000, currency MOP, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitment 0.25 are unchanged; no uncapped price adjustment is added, and any request beyond these rules remains unresolved and requires re-tendering. Each party remains free to reject the draft.
